reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 5 recyclers trading the same material (23% of its feedstock)
Category III share of certificates is 39%, +37% versus what its process route can produce
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.44x the cost floor)
Certificates sold at 0.44x the market median price
52% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month
67% of product sales go to buyers incorporated under a year before the invoice

model_signals.label: membership of a closed trading loop

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
